name: @brianjenkins94/silo
description: silo's command line: what a file under .silo/ can't do — install (nothing under a week old, and the baseline of what each package can do), status (a decision about a feature), check (the code held to the ledger and the baseline) and test (CI's: the tests a change needs). The logic is @brianjenkins94/util/silo; the editor uses the same internals.
